Nadia: Weird spike check 10m window for /v1/stream -> p95 (85ms) < p50 (170ms). No infra deploys. Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
Theo: That usually means a sampling/merging artifact. Which region and sample breakdown?
Nadia: ap-northeast, we rolled a low-latency fallback 12m ago. Raw sample counts: fallback=12k, origin=1.2k. Effective traffic estimate: fallback~1.4k, origin~1.2k.
Rohit: Sampler amplifies fallback events. Our rollup merges tdigest objs and uses raw observed counts as weights -> skew.
Nadia: Query I ran: ```SELECT sample_origin, count(*) raw, percentile(response_ms,0.95) p95, percentile(response_ms,0.5) p50 FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/stream' AND region='ap-northeast' AND ts>now()-10m GROUP BY sample_origin;``` Output: fallback p95=12 p50=8, origin p95=380 p50=200, merged p95=85 p50=170.
Theo: Repro nailed. Short-term UI: show per-origin percentiles as a mini table under the latency chart and add a yellow "percentile-provenance" pill when origins>1 and variance high.
Rohit: Medium-term fix in telemetry: include per-origin effective_count in rollups (instrumentation multiplier * raw_samples) and perform weight-aware tdigest merge. I'll add unit tests that simulate sampling multipliers.
Nadia: Also propose an automated warning rule: if merged_p95 < merged_p50 OR merged_p50 > max(p50_by_origin)+50ms then fire a diagnostic alert linking to per-origin panels and suggested root cause tags (sampling_bias, bucket_artifact).
UIBot: Noted UI task: create feature-flagged toggle "percentile provenance (merged / per-origin / weighted)". PR suggested: github.com/redwood/console/pull/1833
TelemetryBot: Created ticket INC-2026-099: "origin-weighted-merge-and-provenance-pill". Tasks: telemetry schema, aggregator PR, console toggle, alert rule. https://redwood/internal/inc/INC-2026-099
Rohit: I'll open telemetry PR and include a small runbook SQL for reproducing inverted ordering and computing weighted merge. Example runbook snippet: ```WITH o AS (SELECT sample_origin, count(*) raw_n, instrumentation_multiplier mult, tdigest(response_ms) td FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/stream' AND ts>now()-10m GROUP BY sample_origin) SELECT sample_origin, raw_n, mult, approx_percentile(td,0.95) p95, approx_percentile(td,0.5) p50 FROM o;``` Then compute weighted merge using raw_n * mult.
Nadia: Thanks. Please ping eng-runtime before the next routing rollout so we can run a 10m smokecheck that verifies merged percentiles don't invert.
Theo: I'll add "telemetry smokecheck" to the routing rollout checklist and review console PR.
Nadia: Great, shipping short-term UI badge first so we don't mislead customers. :white_check_mark:
